sections.title: Synchronizing the Data to the Client
sections.summary: There are 3 (three) ways of syncing data to the client. Synchronizing on chunk load, synchronizing on block updates and synchronizing with a custom network message.

sections.summary: All OreDictionary names for Minecraft items and blocks can be found in net.minecraftforge.oredict.OreDictionary. A full list will not be included here.

sections.title: Factories
sections.summary: Factories can be used to allow defining recipes and ingredients of a custom type (class). To create your own factory, create a _factories.json.

sections.title: Constants
sections.summary: It is possible to define constant values for your recipes. These values have to be defined within a _constants.json and can be used within any recipe of your mod by just writing #<name>.
